description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEventService class, which manages employee event operations such as saving new events, updating events, and retrieving events within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It uses traits for user role management and date-time helpers, and interacts with the EmployeeEvent DAO and entity classes.

classes.name: EmployeeEventService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee events, including creating, updating, and fetching employee event records, with role and timestamp management.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeEventDao instance, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEvent entity to the database.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves a new EmployeeEvent with specified parameters, setting the creator and timestamp.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves employee events based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the current user's role, or 'System' if not available.

methods.name: saveAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an event indicating an employee has been added.

methods.name: saveUpdateEmployeePersonalDetailsEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an event indicating employee personal details have been updated.

methods.name: saveUpdateJobDetailsEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an event indicating employee job details have been updated.
